If Chase Burns is scratched or is not a starting pitcher, the market will resolve to the fair market price.
If Chase Burns is not a starting pitcher but later enters the game, the market will resolve to the fair market price, relief appearances will not count towards this market.
If Chase Burns is a starting pitcher and records at least one batter faced the market will settle based on strikeouts recorded.
